Option_A_Original_Exact.description: Original raw JSON + JS companion + manifests across 147 bundles
Option_A_Original_Exact.notes: Severe 100% duplication between JSON and JS. High network and storage waste.

Option_B_Custody_Archive_ZSTD.description: Compressed custody archive per bundle (JSON payload compressed with ZSTD-19, manifests intact, JS generated on-demand)
Option_B_Custody_Archive_ZSTD.notes: Bitwise byte-for-byte fidelity preserved upon decompression (decompressed_sha256 == source_sha256). Individual bundle download fully preserved.

Option_C_Analytical_Parquet_ZSTD.description: Analytical Parquet format partitioned by instrument/contract/month (candles and zones in Parquet ZSTD, metadata preserved, JS generated on-demand)
Option_C_Analytical_Parquet_ZSTD.notes: Optimal analytical query format for DuckDB/Arrow/Polars. 10.5x compression ratio on tabular candles and zones.

recommendation.js_policy: NO_SIMULTANEOUS_JS_UPLOAD: JS companion is 100% deterministically generated on-demand via template `window['BUNDLE_{id}'] = {json};`
recommendation.justification: Eliminates ~9.5 GB of redundant network transfer and storage, maintains 100% bitwise round-trip fidelity (decompressed_sha256 == source_sha256), and allows individual bundle retrieval by contract/month without a monolithic archive.
